semester: 1st Semester, 3rd Semester, 4th Semester, 5th Semester or 6th Semester

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to name and explain the central contents and tasks of General Business Administration.
Students are able to classify the course content into the context of knowledge acquired in other courses and identify differences.
Students are able to apply the specifics and tasks to selected practical examples and case studies, independently solve the associated tasks, and present the results.
Students are able to critically reflect on the specifics and tasks of General Business Administration.
Students are able to independently recall the course content and deepen their knowledge through self-study. Ideally, they form study groups that last throughout their studies.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the entrepreneurial functional areas of goods management, financial management, and information management
teaching_methods: Seminar-style instruction with case examples / case studies / exercises
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
